products.name: Vizard AI
products.note: Video repurposing; auto-clipping; social media; content strategy AI

profile_text.body:
Vizard is a web-based video editing platform that uses AI to convert long-form video content into short clips formatted for social media channels such as TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and similar platforms. The company describes itself as the number one AI video editing and clipping tool, and positions its service around reducing the manual effort involved in repurposing video content.

The company's primary product, Vizard AI, offers a range of tools including auto-clipping, subtitle generation, audio transcription, video translation, and dedicated editors oriented toward Instagram and TikTok. Vizard also provides a Team Workspace feature that the company describes as a centralized hub allowing team leaders to invite members, manage projects, and share previews with clients or external collaborators. An API is available for developers seeking to integrate the platform's capabilities.

The held facts confirm Vizard maintains an active page on theworldofai.org and that its product is categorized under Video Generation and Editing. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the available data.
